items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Button with Motion: width-stable loading state, loadingText, tactile press feedback, a `soft` variant and reduced-motion support. Also exports MotionButton.

items.name: status-button
items.title: Status Button
items.description: Button that animates through idle, loading, success and error states with a springy width change, self-drawing check mark and error shake. Includes the useStatusAction hook.

items.name: hold-to-confirm-button
items.title: Hold to Confirm Button
items.description: Press-and-hold button for destructive actions. A fill wipes across while held and springs back if released early. Mouse, touch and keyboard.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: Button with a light sheen that sweeps across on hover or on an idle loop.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: Button that is pulled toward the cursor on spring physics, with a parallax label.

items.name: spotlight-button
items.title: Spotlight Button
items.description: Button with a cursor-following light on its border and surface.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Icon button that copies text to the clipboard and morphs into a check mark.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Input: hover state, softer focus ring, clear invalid state, on-theme autofill and tidy file inputs. CSS only.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code input with a gliding active ring, pop-in digits and an error shake. Paste and SMS autofill supported.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: Input whose label rests inside the field and springs up on focus or when filled.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with animated show/hide toggle and an optional spring-filled strength meter.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: Search field with loading spinner, animated clear button, Escape to clear and a ⌘K focus shortcut.

items.name: shimmer-input
items.title: Shimmer Input
items.description: Input with a light beam travelling around its border while loading, for AI prompt fields.

items.name: neon-button
items.title: Neon Button
items.description: Button that glows like a neon tube. Glow intensifies on hover and keyboard focus, optional flicker-on effect, any CSS color, solid or outline. Built on the DuskUI Button, so loading and loadingText keep working.

items.name: glow-text
items.title: Glow Text
items.description: Real, selectable, SEO-readable text with a layered neon text-shadow glow, optional breathe or flicker animation, any color and any heading level via the as prop.

items.name: neon-border
items.title: Neon Border
items.description: Wrapper that draws an animated neon border around any content: a beam of light travels around the edge with a soft glow. Color, two-tone, speed, thickness, radius and hover trigger props.

items.name: electric-card
items.title: Electric Card
items.description: Card whose border crackles with procedurally generated SVG lightning and glows on hover or keyboard focus. Tunable chaos, arc count, speed, radius and color.

items.name: plasma-loader
items.title: Plasma Loader
items.description: Accessible loading spinner with a plasma effect: glowing blobs orbit a ring and fuse through an SVG gooey filter. Size, color, secondary color, speed and screen-reader label props.

items.name: circuit-board
items.title: Circuit Board
items.description: Animated circuit board background with 45°-routed SVG traces, solder pads and pulses of light travelling along them.

items.name: data-stream
items.title: Data Stream
items.description: Canvas data-flow effect where glowing packets stream along horizontal lanes at varying speeds. A hero accent.

items.name: hologram-card
items.title: Hologram Card
items.description: Holographic card with iridescent foil, rainbow rim, scanlines, and 3D tilt and glare that follow the pointer.

items.name: binary-rain
items.title: Binary Rain
items.description: Falling columns of 0s and 1s with bright heads and fading trails, drawn on a high-DPI canvas.

items.name: tech-grid
items.title: Tech Grid
items.description: Animated tech grid background: cells light up near the cursor under a sweeping scan line, or a retro perspective floor variant.

items.name: terminal-window
items.title: Terminal Window
items.description: Animated terminal window that types out a scripted session: commands typed character by character, output revealed, auto-scroll, blinking cursor, loop/replay and onComplete. Full transcript always in the DOM; reduced motion shows the finished session.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Text with a digital glitch: RGB-split layers jump in clip-path slices on hover, on a loop or once in view. Real text stays selectable; bursts throttled to one per second and off under reduced motion.

items.name: matrix-rain
items.title: Matrix Rain
items.description: Classic Matrix digital rain on a high-DPI canvas with katakana and digits. Configurable color, font size, speed, fade and characters; pauses off-screen and draws a still frame under reduced motion.

items.name: cyber-button
items.title: Cyber Button
items.description: Cyberpunk button built on the DuskUI Button: angled clip-path corners and a monospace label that scrambles then resolves on hover and focus without changing width, plus the loading state.

items.name: scan-line
items.title: Scan Line
items.description: CRT overlay wrapper in pure CSS: horizontal scanlines, a slowly rolling scan bar, optional vignette, flicker and curvature. aria-hidden, pointer-events-none, works in Server Components.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Frosted-glass card with backdrop blur and saturation, gradient hairline border, film grain, a pointer-following specular highlight and optional 3D tilt.

items.name: blur-panel
items.title: Blur Panel
items.description: Backdrop-blur panel for sticky headers, toolbars and sidebars whose blur, saturation and tint fade in with scroll, with intensity presets.

items.name: frost-button
items.title: Frost Button
items.description: Frosted-glass button built on the DuskUI Button with a light sweep on hover and focus, a press ripple, three tones and the loading state.

items.name: crystal-modal
items.title: Crystal Modal
items.description: Glass modal on Radix Dialog with Motion scale-and-blur enter/exit, a frosted overlay, focus trap and Escape to close.

items.name: ice-input
items.title: Ice Input
items.description: Frosted-glass input built on the DuskUI Input where frost spreads from the click point on focus and a cool glow lights the border.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Card: same parts and data-slots, smooth border/shadow transitions, an `interactive` mode (hover lift, tinted border, focus ring) and `asChild`. CSS only.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: Glow Card
items.description: Card whose border lights up where the cursor is, with a soft bloom and surface wash. Driven by motion values and also lights up on keyboard focus.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: Card that tilts in 3D toward the cursor on springs with a moving glare highlight. Mouse only, static with reduced motion.

items.name: loading-card
items.title: Loading Card
items.description: Card that shows a shimmering skeleton while loading, then crossfades the content in while its height springs to fit.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Dialog: smoother open/close animation, blurred backdrop, scrollable content, larger close button and a fade-only reduced-motion mode. Same exports and props.

items.name: morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing Dialog
items.description: A card that morphs into a dialog with shared Motion layoutIds for the surface, media, title and subtitle. Built on Radix Dialog for focus trap, Escape and aria.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Async confirmation dialog: loading confirm button, dismiss blocked mid-request, shake + inline error on failure, optional type-to-confirm. role=alertdialog.

items.name: drawer-dialog
items.title: Drawer Dialog
items.description: Bottom sheet built on Radix Dialog that slides up and can be dragged or flicked down to dismiss, with the backdrop fading as you drag.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Badge with soft, success, warning and info variants, sm/lg sizes, a status `dot` and hover states for link badges. CSS only.

items.name: pulse-badge
items.title: Pulse Badge
items.description: Status badge with a pulsing ring around its dot for Live, Online or Deploying states. Also exports PulseDot.

items.name: animated-count-badge
items.title: Animated Count Badge
items.description: Count badge whose digits roll like an odometer on springs, with a bump on increase, max+ capping and a screen-reader label.

items.name: shimmer-badge
items.title: Shimmer Badge
items.description: Badge with a band of light sweeping across it every few seconds, for New, Beta or Pro labels.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: A soft, slowly shifting aurora of blurred gradient bands animated with GPU-friendly transforms.

items.name: background-beams
items.title: Background Beams
items.description: Thin beams of light travelling along a fan of curved SVG paths with soft tails and bright heads.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: A drifting canvas particle field that repels from or gathers toward the cursor, with optional connecting lines.

items.name: dot-spotlight
items.title: Dot Spotlight
items.description: A dot-grid background with a soft spotlight that follows the cursor and brightens nearby dots.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Shooting stars with glowing heads and fading tails streaking diagonally across the container at staggered intervals.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes a list of phrases with a blinking caret. Reserves the size of the longest phrase (no layout shift), pauses off-screen and keeps every phrase in the DOM for SEO and screen readers.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Animated number that springs to its value when it scrolls into view. Intl.NumberFormat locales, currency, decimals, prefix and suffix, tabular digits, final value rendered on the server.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Cycles through words with a vertical slide and blur swap while the container width springs between them.

items.name: scroll-reveal-text
items.title: Scroll Reveal Text
items.description: Paragraph whose words light up one by one as it scrolls through the viewport. Scroll-linked Motion values with no React re-renders.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: Real, selectable text with a band of light sweeping across it via a background-clip text gradient, on any heading level.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: Letters or words stagger in with a rise, drop, blur or fade when the text scrolls into view, with server-rendered final text.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Avatar: soft image fade-in once loaded, hairline edge and an on-theme initials fallback.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping avatar stack that fans out on hover, lifts the hovered avatar with a name tag and collapses extras into a +N chip.

items.name: status-avatar
items.title: Status Avatar
items.description: Avatar with an online/away/busy/offline dot and ring; live statuses pulse and status changes pop.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Progress: spring-animated indicator, fill-in on mount, indeterminate sweep and indicatorClassName.

items.name: circular-progress
items.title: Circular Progress
items.description: SVG progress ring that springs to its value while the center number counts along. Radix progressbar semantics.

items.name: stepper-progress
items.title: Stepper Progress
items.description: Multi-step stepper: connectors fill with a spring, completed steps draw a check, the current step breathes.

items.name: segmented-progress
items.title: Segmented Progress
items.description: Progress bar split into segments that fill one after another from a single spring; the filling segment glows.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Slider: thumb grows with a halo while dragging, gradient range, labels forwarded to thumbs. Single, range and vertical.

items.name: value-slider
items.title: Value Slider
items.description: Slider with a floating value bubble on each thumb that springs up on hover, focus or drag. Supports ranges.

items.name: stepped-slider
items.title: Stepped Slider
items.description: Slider that snaps between named steps with tick marks that light up and clickable labels.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Dropdown Menu: grows from the trigger's side, smoother highlights, popping check/radio indicators. Same exports and props.

items.name: animated-dropdown
items.title: Animated Dropdown
items.description: Dropdown menu that springs open with staggered items and a highlight pill that glides between items via a shared layoutId.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Popover: grows out of its trigger, slides from its side, plus PopoverClose.

items.name: animated-popover
items.title: Animated Popover
items.description: Motion popover that springs from the trigger's transform origin with a blur-in and optional arrow.

items.name: feedback-popover
items.title: Feedback Popover
items.description: Feedback button that morphs into a textarea panel via shared layoutIds, with async submit, inline error and a success state.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Tabs: a `line` variant with a growing underline, vertical orientation, panels that fade and rise in. CSS only.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a pill or underline indicator that glides between triggers, direction-aware panel slides and a springing panel height.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: iOS-style segmented control on native radios with a springing thumb; form-ready.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Accordion: smoother height, quicker close, content that fades and un-blurs in, overshooting chevron, `icon` prop. CSS only.

items.name: motion-accordion
items.title: Motion Accordion
items.description: Spring-physics accordion with a gliding hover highlight and mint outline on the open item; closed answers stay in the DOM for SEO.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ Accordion
items.description: Data-driven FAQ section with numbered questions, plus-to-minus icon and optional FAQPage JSON-LD. Server Component friendly.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Switch: spring-loaded thumb (CSS linear()), glowing on state, sm/default/lg sizes, thumbContent.

items.name: icon-switch
items.title: Icon Switch
items.description: Theme toggle whose thumb morphs from a sun into a crescent moon, or spins between any two icons.

items.name: loading-switch
items.title: Loading Switch
items.description: Async switch that moves optimistically, spins while onCheckedChange resolves and springs back with a shake on error.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Checkbox: the check draws itself, indeterminate draws a dash, pure CSS so forms keep working.

items.name: task-checkbox
items.title: Task Checkbox
items.description: To-do row whose label strikes through across wrapped lines with a ring and particle burst.

items.name: checkbox-card
items.title: Checkbox Card
items.description: Selectable card whose mint outline traces itself; the icon lifts and the check draws.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Tooltip: elevated surface with a bordered arrow, opens with scale, slide and blur. Same exports and props.

items.name: animated-tooltip
items.title: Animated Tooltip
items.description: Spring tooltip with a one-line API that scales and un-blurs out of its trigger and animates out.

items.name: avatar-tooltip-group
items.title: Avatar Tooltip Group
items.description: Overlapping avatars with name cards that tilt toward the cursor and a +N overflow chip.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinitely scrolling row or column for logos and testimonials: seamless transform-only loop, pause on hover/focus, fade edges, static under reduced motion.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Responsive bento layout with column/row spans; cards reveal a CTA, zoom their background and follow the cursor with a glow on hover or focus.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Notification-style list where new items spring in at the top and older ones glide down, with a max visible count and a polite live region.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical timeline whose progress line traces down as you scroll (works in scroll containers), with dots that light up and sticky dates.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop dropzone on a real file input with animated drag-over, validation errors, and a file list with per-file progress, cancel and retry.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Select that grows out of its trigger, flips its chevron and pops in the check mark.

items.name: animated-select
items.title: Animated Select
items.description: Select whose list springs open, options cascade in, a highlight pill glides between items and the check pops in.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Radio Group with a dot that springs in and a mint glow when checked.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio Cards
items.description: Selectable plan cards with a glowing outline that glides to the selected card.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Textarea that grows with its content, with hover, focus and invalid states.

items.name: auto-resize-textarea
items.title: Auto-resize Textarea
items.description: Textarea that springs to fit its content, with a character-limit ring that turns amber then red.

items.name: chat-input
items.title: Chat Input
items.description: Chat composer with an auto-growing textarea, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line and a loading send button.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Toggle with a tactile press and a mint on state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Toggle Group with variants, sizes, spacing and a mint on state.

items.name: animated-toggle-group
items.title: Animated Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle group whose active pill glides between items (single) or springs in per item (multiple).

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Animated searchable select with spring open, layout-animated filtering, match highlighting and an empty state.

items.name: multi-combobox
items.title: Multi-select Combobox
items.description: Autocomplete multi-select with animated removable chips, self-drawing checkboxes and an optional max.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Pagination built on the DuskUI Button variants.

items.name: animated-pagination
items.title: Animated Pagination
items.description: Controlled pagination with an active indicator that glides between pages, smart ellipsis range and rolling page numbers.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Breadcrumb with hover and current-page states.

items.name: collapsible-breadcrumb
items.title: Collapsible Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb whose middle items fold into an animated ellipsis menu when there are too many.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Dependency-free Motion carousel with drag, momentum and snap, arrows, dots, keyboard, loop and autoplay that pauses on hover and reduced motion.

items.name: coverflow-carousel
items.title: Coverflow Carousel
items.description: 3D coverflow carousel where slides rotate and scale around the active one, driven by a single drag motion value.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: macOS-style dock whose icons magnify toward the cursor with springs, with labels, active dots, keyboard focus and a vertical option.

items.name: floating-navbar
items.title: Floating Navbar
items.description: Navbar that hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up, with a gliding active-link pill and animated mobile menu; works in scroll containers.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Alert with success, warning and info variants alongside default and destructive.

items.name: dismissible-alert
items.title: Dismissible Alert
items.description: Alert that collapses its height when dismissed, with optional auto-dismiss and a draining progress line.

items.name: banner-alert
items.title: Banner Alert
items.description: Top-of-page announcement banner that slides in and can be dismissed.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Alert Dialog with a blurred backdrop and scale-in surface, using the DuskUI Button for actions.

items.name: destructive-alert-dialog
items.title: Destructive Alert Dialog
items.description: Destructive confirmation with a pulsing warning icon, optional type-to-confirm, async loading action and a shake on error.

items.name: session-timeout-dialog
items.title: Session Timeout Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog that counts down to sign-out with a draining ring and a stay-signed-in action.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: DuskUI-styled Sonner Toaster: on-theme surfaces, icons and actions. Same Toaster export and props.

items.name: animated-toast
items.title: Animated Toast
items.description: Custom Sonner toast whose icon morphs from loading to success or error, with a duration progress bar.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: Undo pattern for destructive actions: a toast with a countdown and an Undo button that cancels the action.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Skeleton with a shimmer sweep that turns static under reduced motion.

items.name: skeleton-presets
items.title: Skeleton Presets
items.description: Ready-made skeletons for text lines, avatar rows, cards and tables.

items.name: content-loader
items.title: Content Loader
items.description: Crossfades a skeleton into real content while the height springs to fit.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Drop-in shadcn Hover Card that grows out of its trigger.

items.name: profile-hover-card
items.title: Profile Hover Card
items.description: User preview card that springs from the trigger origin with avatar, bio and stats.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link Preview
items.description: Hover a link to see a preview panel with a skeleton while it loads.
